title: Scan4D Metadata JSON Schema
description: Metadata generated alongside a Scan4D mesh export

timestamp.description: Unix epoch time (UTC) when the capture reached completion.

device.description: The custom user-defined name of the device capturing the scan (e.g., Jane's iPhone).

hardware_device_model.description: The specific hardware model capturing the scan (e.g., iPhone 15 Pro, Ray-Ban Meta).

os_name.description: The operating system running on the device (e.g., iOS, Android, visionOS).

os_version.description: The specific version of the operating system (e.g., 17.4).

app_version.description: The version of the capture application (e.g., 1.0.0).

build_type.description: The build configuration used for the capture application.

location_id.description: The UUID of the ScanLocation this capture belongs to.

gps_latitude.description: GPS latitude, present if location tracking is available.

gps_longitude.description: GPS longitude, present if location tracking is available.

gps_altitude.description: GPS altitude in meters, present if location tracking is available.

compass_heading.description: True heading (or magnetic if true isn't available) in degrees 0-359.9.

face_anchors.description: 3D locations of detected faces for privacy filtering.

semantic_labeling.description: Whether ARKit mesh classification was enabled during this capture.

semantic_classes_detected.description: List of semantic class names detected during capture (e.g., wall, floor, table).

keyframe_count.description: Number of sharp stillness keyframes captured (hi-res stills when the device supports them, stream frames otherwise).

privacy_filter.description: Whether the person-privacy filter was enabled for this capture (one binary state per scan — the toggle is locked during recording). True: person regions are pixelated in exported RGB and zeroed in depth. Absent on legacy scans that predate the flag.

low_power_mode.description: Whether iOS Low Power Mode was active when the capture stopped. LPM throttling is a suspected contributor to silent tracking excursions (outlier feature clusters) under continuous normal tracking.

worldmap_suspect.description: Present and true when the saved relocalization world map's feature cloud carried a wandering outlier cluster (a tracking excursion baked into the session map, e.g. an OS interruption with device motion). Camera poses recorded before the excursion may disagree with the final mesh frame, and relocalizing later scans against this map can seat them with an offset — weight this dataset's poses/registration accordingly.

photo_coverage.description: How much of the depth-scanned geometry was covered by sharp keyframe photos, measured on a coarse world-space voxel grid (occlusion-correct: only surfaces a keyframe's depth map actually measured are counted).

covered_voxels.description: Voxels containing mesh that were photographed by at least one sharp keyframe.

occupied_voxels.description: Voxels containing mesh geometry (the coverage denominator).

fraction.description: covered_voxels / occupied_voxels, 0..1. Low values mean splat texture quality will be limited to sweep-frame detail in the uncovered regions.

voxel_size_m.description: Edge length in meters of a coverage voxel cell.

mean_still_overlap.description: Mean still-to-still voxel overlap across the session's keyframes (0..1, first still excluded). Photogrammetry rule of thumb targets ~0.6; low values mean the stills form isolated islands with texture seams between them.

standpoint_diversity.description: Fraction of photo-covered voxels photographed from >= 2 distinct camera standpoints (~0.5m position cells). Parallax/baseline diversity — the primary multi-view quality signal; rotation-in-place does not increase it. Intended for offline correlation of capture properties against splat quality.
